AIIMS report links gym belt to Twisha Sharma's injuries, CBI studies findings

An AIIMS Delhi medical board has submitted a final forensic report to the CBI in the Twisha Sharma death case. The report confirms that skin tissue found on a gymnastics belt matches the injury pattern on Sharma's neck. This finding, submitted under court orders, is expected to aid the CBI in reconstructing the events leading to her death.
